curriculum.lesson_evidence: Australian symbols (flags, anthem, emblems) express aspects of national identity. The Aboriginal flag and Torres Strait Islander flag are official flags; their meanings should be taught from published descriptions (e.g. designers Harold Thomas; Bernard Namok).
curriculum.scope_limit: Proposed Stage 2 NESA HSIE alignment using catalogue outcome codes (HS2-*); content-point mapping and local First Nations protocols remain pending human review.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Match: Aboriginal flag designer; yellow disc meaning (as commonly published); Commonwealth Star.

FEEDBACK
Harold Thomas; sun; states/territories (+ territories point) — accept curriculum-standard meanings.

WATCH FOR

Create a symbols booklet page for three official flags + one emblem with published meanings and designers where known.
